_doc: Editorial choices for the featured clips, which fetch-data.mjs downloads from the landing page's showcase. `order`: channels in the order the edit uses them (the bot scene shows the first two); channels not listed follow in showcase order. `inpoints`: by Twitch clip slug, where the ~1 s the edit shows starts, instead of the automatic pick (the loudest 1.2 s with a lit, moving picture). Each choice says why.
order_why: jynxzi: the strongest on-camera reaction. duxxion: the streamer the live campaign is for, and a goal. stableronaldo last: at its moment the stream's chat overlay shows a viewer line ('what the gay') that does not belong in an advert.

SolidInterestingFlyHotPokket-RnyTxazcWnE.why: duxxion's goal: the ball crosses the line at ~13.9 s and PASTA SCORED lands at ~14.3 s. The shot is on screen for 2.3 s, so it starts at 12.2 s and ends before the stream's pause menu (~14.6 s) and the dim desktop it tabs out to (~15 s), which is also the clip's loudest stretch.
